Day 1 for Week 2:
Today,  I've been brainstorming about project ideas and have come up with this. I will create a new PCB instead of using my old one because want to focus on a new project and gain more experience. I sourced the internet for a image that is similar to the one I'm building as a reference. One image looks to be in a cad software, while the other looks to be built already. I've also research what the PCB will do and parts needed for it.
